# Smelloff

> Smelloff is a Hyderabad-based D2C men's grooming brand. Its first product, ODORSTRIKE, is a pocket-sized fabric odor eliminator — a 50ml mist that traps and neutralizes sweat smell, gym odor and shirt funk in seconds. For use on fabrics and clothing only. Not a perfume. Not a deodorant. Not for application to skin.

## Who Smelloff is for

Indian men dealing with sweat smell on shirts, gym clothes that smell even after washing, and the social worry of being noticed for odor. Built for the Indian climate — hot summers, high humidity, daily polyester wear, and re-wearing clothes between washes.

## Why ODORSTRIKE exists

Deodorant treats your skin — a small fraction of the surface that holds odor. Your clothing holds most of it. ODORSTRIKE treats the fabric directly. It doesn't mask odor with fragrance; it binds the odor molecules (isovaleric acid, butyric acid, sulfur compounds) and neutralizes them so they can't volatilize to your nose.

## Product facts

- Name: ODORSTRIKE (product) under Smelloff (brand)
- Category: Fabric odor eliminator / fabric mist
- Size: 50ml pocket bottle, ~250 sprays
- Pricing (honest, inclusive of taxes): ₹229 Solo · ₹399 2-Pack (save ₹59) · ₹549 3-Pack (save ₹138)

- Shipping: free across India over ₹499; COD available pan-India
- Dispatch: within 1–2 business days; delivery 3–7 business days
- Returns: 7-day return window
- Works on: cotton, polyester, denim, wool and everyday blends
- Not for: skin, leather, suede, silk, dry-clean-only fabrics
- Dry time: a few seconds, residue-free

## Hero active ingredient

Zinc PCA — a zinc complex used in skin-safe odor control for years. It binds volatile odor molecules in fabric and prevents them from volatilizing (becoming airborne and detectable). True neutralization, not masking. Triethyl citrate (plant-derived) helps break down the sweat acids bacteria leave behind.

## Formulation

- Water — base
- Isopropyl alcohol — fast-drying carrier, helps fiber penetration
- Triethyl citrate — breaks down sweat acids
- Zinc PCA — hero active, binds and neutralizes odor molecules
- Fabric-safe fragrance — subtle, fades quickly
- Polysorbate 20 — emulsifier
- Phenoxyethanol & ethylhexylglycerin — preservative

## How to use ODORSTRIKE

1. Hold the bottle ~15cm from the fabric.
2. Mist 2–3 sprays on the areas that hold odor — collar, underarms, chest, gym-bag lining.
3. Wait a few seconds for it to dry.
4. Wear it out. Odor stays neutralized through active wear; re-apply after heavy sweating.

## What ODORSTRIKE is not

It is not a deodorant, perfume or cosmetic, and must not be applied to skin. It refreshes clothes between washes — it does not replace washing. Launder heavily soiled garments normally.
